narrative.headline: The Wild lead the power rankings
narrative.blurb: 47 games on this week's slate. The Wild are No. 1 at 17-3-4 with a +35 goal differential. The East's last playoff spot is the Panthers on 27 points. The West's last spot is the Mammoth on 25 points. The Wild lead the heat check at 3-0-0 and +11 goals over the last three games.

top.magicTitle: 110 more points guarantees a wild card, no matter how the rest of the West finishes. A win is worth 2. An overtime loss still hands the other team a point. The other route needs 114.
